security_spec.violation_condition: In the Linux kernel RISC-V IOMMU driver, when a Device Context (DC) is configured with iohgatp.MODE=Bare (second-stage translation disabled, e.g., for host-owned devices or when KVM is not in use) but msiptp.MODE is not set to Off, the IOMMU may perform MSI address translations without a valid GSCID, allowing MSI page table walks to associate translations with an undefined VM address space.
security_spec.summary: Setting msiptp.MODE != Off when iohgatp.MODE=Bare causes MSI translations to proceed without a valid GSCID, potentially misdirecting MSI interrupts across VM boundaries or between guest and host, enabling cross-VM interrupt injection
